rubrics.description: Return the number of empty cell

rubric_assessments.justification: Student correctly uses IF function with COUNTIF to check if empty cell count is zero and returns 'Aucune cellule vide'.
Formula logic is inverted - checks for text equality instead of properly detecting empty cells in the range.
Formula returns COUNTIF result which is the number of empty cells when not zero.
Student demonstrates knowledge of IF and COUNTIF syntax, not a completely failed attempt.
Student includes IF function in C1 formula, though the condition logic is incorrect.
Uses COUNT instead of COUNTIF and checks for non-zero values rather than actual empty cells.
Student provides number 9 in A7 which appears to represent count of relevant items, though exact correspondence to empty cells is unclear.
Student shows partial understanding with correct function name (IF) and correct range (A1:A100), not entirely wrong.
